ADSL.DISCONFL.CR-5.reason: Define-XML ADSL.DISCONFL (workbook Methods!D102) compares DCREASCD with Completed, and the original ItemRef IT.ADSL.DCSREAS (define-adam.xml lines 275-276) and Variables!O190 bind the DCREASCD method to DCSREAS, so the probe's REF.DCSREAS reading is the rule as written. The reference leaves DCSREAS blank for the 110 reported subjects, so the documented inequality flags them Y where the reference flag is empty.
ADSL.DISCONFL.CR-5.title: Discontinuation flag disagrees with the documented rule for completed subjects

ADSL.VISNUMEN.CR-5.reason: Define-XML ADSL.VISNUMEN (workbook Methods!D133) reads DS.VISITNUM only where DSTERM='PROTCOL COMPLETED', and adsl-documented-rules.yaml P4_COMPLETE keeps that spelling verbatim. The staged DS spells the completion term PROTOCOL COMPLETED, so the literal probe is missing on every record where the reference holds a visit number.
ADSL.VISNUMEN.CR-5.title: Completion-visit rule does not reproduce the ADaM endpoint visit
